classifications.rationale: The President establishes and staffs an interagency task force, assigns its planning mission, and permits members to designate representatives. These are internal organizational acts, not changes to legal rights or dictated agency legal outcomes.
classifications.evidence: There is established a Task Force on Space Industry Workforce and Economic Development

classifications.rationale: The segment assigns the Task Force meeting, coordination, advisory, outreach-support, and discretionary resource-support functions. It neither fixes a legally consequential result nor itself alters rights, funding, or eligibility.
classifications.evidence: The Task Force will perform the following functions, to the extent permitted by law

classifications.rationale: The Task Force must conduct outreach and hold stakeholder meetings, which are internal advisory and information-gathering activities without a substantive legal consequence.
classifications.evidence: The Task Force shall hold inaugural meetings with stakeholders within 60 days of the date of this memorandum.

classifications.rationale: The segment requires preparation of a recommendatory plan and sets the administrative lifespan of the Task Force. It does not itself invest the referenced funding or compel agencies to implement a specified legal result.
classifications.evidence: the Task Force shall develop and submit to the President a comprehensive plan

classifications.rationale: Agency heads must provide administrative support and information, agencies bear their participation expenses, and savings clauses preserve existing authority and OMB functions. These are internal management and housekeeping provisions.
classifications.evidence: The heads of executive departments and agencies shall assist and provide information to the Task Force
